correctness.rationale: The quantity is the minimum over projections that fix the circulation subspace, in the weighted edge ℓ1 norm. Conservation gives s=Dr. Finite dihedral conjugation preserves both the range constraint and the identity on that range, so averaging preserves the projection and cannot increase its norm. Reflection sends rim index i to −i−1 with reversed rim orientation and sends spoke index i to −i without reversal. This gives the stated antisymmetry. The two weighted column norms follow from B=I−AD and AD=DA. For the two-entry kernel v, b has masses 1−2v,v,v at indices 0,1,−1; its variation is 2−4v up to v=1/3 and 8v−2 immediately above it, with v<1/2. Solving equality of the first branch and the spoke norm yields v=t(1+2t)/(2Z), and v≤1/3 iff 2t²−t−2≤0. For the lower certificate, apply D twice to e_j−e_{m−1−j} and pair with the five-entry q. This gives (4,1,1) for m=6, (4,1,0) for m=7, and (4,1,0,−1,0,…) for m≥8 (by the support of the cyclic second difference). The bound on the remaining coefficients, sum b=1, and zero sum of Da give the two supporting inequalities. The weighted average with coefficients 2t²/Z and (1+2t)/Z cancels a_0 and leaves the positive penalty t(3−2t)/Z on the other entries. The minimum is attained since the antisymmetric problem is continuous and S(a)≥||a||_1/t makes a bounded sublevel compact. Thus equality would force support on the two entries and S=T; above t_* it contradicts the switched variation formula. At t=t_* the two variation branches coincide. For m=3,4,5 the linear-profile kernel gives b_0=1−2v and b_i=2v/(m−1) for i≠0. The proposed v satisfies 2mv≤m−1 (after clearing the denominator the difference is (m−1)H_m+(2m−4)t>0), which justifies the variation sign in U_m. The three differences from F and the stated derivative of F check by algebra. These checks include the tied edge presentation at t=1/2 and do not extend the strict result to t≥3/2.
residual_risks: Packaged checks inspected, not executed. The reported 520 rational cases plus 30 small-wheel cases and the 20 finite-precision unrestricted LP cases do not prove the continuum result.

Independent spot-check replay: form D by subtracting each coordinate's cyclic predecessor, evaluate q·D(D(e_j−e_{m−1−j})) for m=6,7,8,9,61, and evaluate the two displayed column norms at t=1/2,t_* and above the threshold. The uniform certificate and attainment argument, not these spot checks, establish strictness.

value.rationale: The invariant controls the best bounded linear retraction onto circulations, not just the performance of a chosen projector. A single optimal formula independent of rim count under a natural two-orbit metric deformation, together with a provably sharp cutoff in rim count and the failure of the formula precisely when a column variation changes sign, is useful structural information. The finite-support dual witness explains the uniformity across all larger wheels and the sharp threshold; this is not merely computing the norm of a trial matrix or recovering the unit slice.
residual_risks: The post-threshold optimum and the smaller-wheel optima as functions of t are not computed; the value assessment does not rely on an exact solution there.
